sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, travel to Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. The leaders arrive in excellent form with five consecutive wins before a recent draw, and face an Alsager side struggling near the bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 games. This should represent a significant test of Sandbach's title credentials against one of the league's weakest performers.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town at 15:00, providing an opportunity to close the gap on leaders Sandbach; Stafford's mixed recent form (draw-win-win) contrasts with Dawley's inconsistency. AFC Bridgnorth, third and in-form, face Eccleshall at home in a mid-table clash. Wolverhampton Casuals entertain Wednesfield Community in a battle between two sides competing for European places—Casuals recent form shows a win, while Wednesfield have one win in their last six. Bilston Town (5th, strong recent form) visit Foley Meir (11th) in a fixture that favours the visitors. Market Drayton Town host New Mills, with both sides struggling—New Mills on a poor run of losses. Crewe face Allscott Heath in a basement-area contest between two inconsistent sides. Shawbury United's disastrous form (one win in last six) is tested at home against Barnton, who have steadier mid-table credentials. Finally, Brereton Social host Widnes Town, the division's bottom side with just 2 points; Brereton's recent draw-loss-win pattern suggests marginal improvement, but Widnes remain winless and severely depleted on goal difference.
